scripts.tokens: node scripts/build-tokens.mjs && node scripts/build-i18n.mjs && node scripts/build-icons.mjs
scripts.build: npm run tokens && tsc --noEmit && vite build
scripts.check: npm run tokens && npm run schemas:check && biome ci . && tsc --noEmit && vitest run
scripts.schemas:check: npm run schemas && git ls-files --error-unmatch src/generated/schemas.ts src/generated/node-types.json src/generated/templates.json >/dev/null && test -z "$(git status --porcelain -- src/generated/schemas.ts src/generated/node-types.json src/generated/templates.json)" || (echo 'schemas.ts drift: regenerate and commit src/generated/schemas.ts, node-types.json, templates.json' && exit 1)
